text:
Review · 2026-11-25
Paths checked on paper: Home → competition → questions → mock exams; avatar → Performance → weak topic → filtered questions. Ordinary practice is scoped to one competition; only mock exams may mix competitions. Usability still needs prototype testing.
Sitemap: destinations are blue; white boxes describe page content or features, not separate pages. The map is one part of information architecture.
Sources: [NN/g: Information architecture vs. sitemaps](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/information-architecture-sitemaps/) · [NN/g: Tree testing](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/tree-testing/) · [MoJ: Organising your site](https://websitebuilder.service.justice.gov.uk/designing-your-site/site-structure/) · [Sitemap image example](https://www.freecodecamp.org/news/information-architecture-userflow-sitemap/)
